Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 3 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.

START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_SAFE_TO_ALERT. Room positions match the previous block. Exactly three guards approach outside: A leads, B follows, C is last. Indoor and corridor shots depict simultaneous adjacent spaces. The cat remains beside Shahrnaz.

SHOT 03 | 00:00-00:06 | THE SISTERS
50mm calm two-shot. Shahrnaz keeps her right palm on the cat and touches Arnavaz’s wrist with her left hand. Arnavaz briefly covers it. Distant footfalls draw Arnavaz’s masked head toward the doorway. Her posture becomes upright; Shahrnaz brings both hands around the cat.
SHOT 04 | 00:06-00:12 | THREE GUARDS
Cut outside to a 28mm shoulder-height retreating handheld shot. A, B and C advance through the referenced corridor toward the room, traveling left-to-right. Their uneven spacing and forward shoulders suggest predatory purpose. End as A reaches the door; the camera steps into the existing side recess.
SHOT 05 | 00:12-00:15 | THE THRESHOLD
Cut to a 50mm side detail: A’s right palm plants against the door; B and C remain staggered behind him. Hold pressure for one beat. End with the door still closed, immediately before it is forced inward.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
Preserve the room’s warm window direction. Corridor shots use the approved colder localized practical light. Each space retains its own exposure.
SOUND
Soft sleeve contact inside; approaching boots outside, initially muffled and then close. Finger and garment contact from the musician remains unpitched. Keep all voices unspoken.
END STATE AND EDIT
A’s right hand touches the closed door. Inside, Shahrnaz cups the cat with both hands, ready to lift it; Arnavaz has turned toward the entrance.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
